decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds directly on the firm's long-established trommel screening knowledge and an existing customer base, so the firm can read market feedback and keep refining it.
Mobile flail shredding sits close to the firm's core mobile comminution competence and has its own page, so the firm can assimilate field results via telematics and service and improve the line.

The high-speed grinder draws on related mobile shredding knowledge, but its low visibility and overlap with the green-waste grinder raise the risk of consolidation; keeping it still preserves learning in that segment.

The stationary electric fine shredder lies further from the mobile core and gets limited visibility, but it supports the stated push toward plant-based, resource-saving solutions where the firm is building knowledge.
The green-waste grinder serves established composting and biomass customers using existing know-how, though overlap with Product C could lead to a merger of the two lines.
The single-shaft pre-shredders build on the firm's core shredder expertise and stationary plant ambitions, giving it the related knowledge needed to improve them.
